international.label: International Guests
international.tickets: Taj Mahal entry for foreign nationals is about ₹1,300, plus ₹200 to enter the main mausoleum. Agra Fort is about ₹650. Rates are set by the ASI and can change.
international.payment: 20% advance by bank transfer, card or PayPal confirms the booking. The balance is paid in cash (USD, EUR, GBP or INR) or by transfer after the tour.
international.language: Your photographer and guide speak English; Hindi, Urdu, French and Spanish guides are available on request.
extras: Carry your passport — it is required to buy monument tickets.
Sunrise entry is 30 minutes before sunrise; we share the exact meeting time the evening before.
The Taj Mahal is closed to visitors on Fridays.

india.label: Indian Guests
india.tickets: Taj Mahal entry for Indian nationals is about ₹50, plus ₹200 to enter the main mausoleum. Agra Fort is about ₹50. Rates are set by the ASI and can change.
india.payment: 20% advance by UPI, bank transfer or card confirms the booking. The balance is paid after the tour by UPI, cash or transfer.
india.language: Hindi, Urdu aur English — aapki pasand ki language mein photographer aur guide available hain.
extras: Carry a government photo ID — it is required to buy monument tickets.
Sunrise entry is 30 minutes before sunrise; we share the exact meeting time the evening before.
The Taj Mahal is closed to visitors on Fridays.
